name: WorkInGYM
schedule: Saturday / Monday / Wednesday by default; three nonconsecutive full-body sessions.
progression: Weeks 1-2: two working sets with 3-4 repetitions left. From week 3: optional third set for the first three exercises, only when recovery is good. Increase load after reaching the top of every set with good control and at least two repetitions left.

weekGuidance.label: Find your starting point
weekGuidance.guidance: Two working sets per exercise. Finish with 3–4 clean repetitions left. Learn the equipment and record comfortable starting weights.

weekGuidance.label: Repeat with control
weekGuidance.guidance: Keep two sets and 3–4 repetitions in reserve. Add repetitions within your range when your movement stays comfortable.

weekGuidance.label: Build when ready
weekGuidance.guidance: If recovery is good, enable the optional third set for the first three exercises. Keep 2–3 repetitions in reserve.

weekGuidance.label: Make progress repeatable
weekGuidance.guidance: Reach the top of your repetition range on every set with at least two repetitions left before adding the smallest weight increase.

weekGuidance.label: Small steps count
weekGuidance.guidance: Progress one thing at a time: repetitions, then load. Keep the same exercises and equipment settings so your logs are comparable.

weekGuidance.label: Review your block
weekGuidance.guidance: Review your weights, consistency, comfort and recovery. Do not automatically restart the block or test maximum lifts. Use your logs to plan what comes next.

days.title: Push emphasis
days.summary: A steady start. Build your pressing strength, then balance it with supported back work, legs and core.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Keep your pelvis against the pad. Straighten your legs under control without snapping your knees backward.

demo.title: How To Do A 45 Degree Leg Press
demo.note: The demo uses a 45-degree machine. Ask staff to show you the settings on your gym’s model.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.cue: Set the handles around mid-chest. Keep your head comfortably supported and use a pain-free range.

demo.title: How To Do A Seated Chest Press

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
exercises.cue: Keep your chest on the pad. Pull smoothly without lifting your chin or shrugging.

demo.title: How To Do An Incline Row (Chest Supported Row)
demo.note: The demo uses dumbbells on an incline bench. A chest-supported row machine is also suitable.

exercises.name: Seated hamstring curl
exercises.cue: Align your knees with the machine pivot. Control the curl and the return.

demo.title: Seated Leg Curl Video Exercise Guide

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.cue: Use light weights. Raise through a comfortable range without swinging or shrugging.

demo.title: Dumbbell Lateral Raise Video Exercise Guide

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: Exhale as you extend opposite limbs. Shorten the movement before your lower back arches.

demo.title: How To Do Deadbugs

days.title: Recovery day
days.summary: An easy walk is enough. Let yesterday’s work settle and return fresh for Session B.

days.title: Pull emphasis
days.summary: Build your pulling strength and shoulder control, with supported single-leg work and a simple hip extension.

exercises.name: Neutral-grip lat pulldown
exercises.cue: Use parallel handles with palms facing each other. Pull toward your upper chest without swinging.

demo.title: How To Do A Close Grip (Neutral) Lat Pulldown

exercises.name: Supported split squat
exercises.cue: Begin with body weight and hold a stable support. Lower straight down through a comfortable range.

demo.title: How To Do Split Squats
demo.note: Hold a stable support and start without weights. The demo shows the same stationary movement without support.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.cue: Use a modest bench incline. Keep your head supported, wrists steady and feet planted.

demo.title: How To Do An Incline Dumbbell Press

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Push through your feet and lift through your hips. Finish before your lower back starts to arch.

demo.title: How To Do A Glute Bridge

exercises.name: Reverse pec deck
exercises.cue: Keep your chest supported. Open your arms smoothly without shrugging or forcing the end range.

demo.title: Reverse Pec Deck

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.cue: Keep your upper arms still. Lower slowly rather than swinging your body.

demo.title: How To Do A Double Arm Curl (Dumbbell Bicep Curl)
demo.note: The demo is seated. Keep your upper arms steady if you perform your curls standing.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.cue: Stand side-on to a cable at chest height. Press forward while keeping your torso facing ahead.

demo.title: Pallof Press

days.title: Easy cardio
days.summary: Walk or cycle at a pace that lets you speak in full sentences. Keep it easy enough to support tomorrow’s lifting.

days.title: Leg emphasis
days.summary: Practise your squat and hip hinge, then round out the week with chest, back, calves and trunk stability.

exercises.name: Goblet squat to a bench
exercises.cue: Hold a light dumbbell at your chest. Touch a stable bench lightly, then stand under control.

demo.title: How To Do A Goblet Squat
demo.note: Use a stable bench behind you. Touch it lightly rather than dropping or rocking onto it.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Ask a trainer to check your hip hinge first. Push your hips backward, keep the weights close and stop before your back rounds.

demo.title: How to do a Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift | Proper Form & Technique | NASM

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.cue: Keep your head supported. Press through a comfortable range without forcing your shoulders backward.

demo.title: How To Do A Seated Chest Press

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.cue: Keep your torso steady and your neck relaxed. Avoid rocking backward to finish the pull.

demo.title: How To Do A Seated Cable Row

exercises.name: Calf raise
exercises.cue: Hold a support for balance. Pause briefly at the top and lower slowly.

demo.title: How To Do A Calf Raise

exercises.name: Rope triceps pressdown
exercises.cue: Keep your elbows near your sides. Straighten your arms without moving your shoulders or leaning on the rope.

demo.title: Tricep Pushdown - Rope

exercises.name: Side plank — knees bent
exercises.cue: Start on your forearm and bent knees. Keep breathing; stop before your hips sag.

demo.title: Side Plank - On Knees

days.title: Optional movement
days.summary: Choose an easy walk or a few comfortable mobility movements. Skip this if you need the rest.

days.title: Rest & reset
days.summary: Take the day off planned training. Check your energy and recovery before the next week. Missed sessions do not need to be combined.
